title: SII Vol. 18 No. 10
location_detail: In the Deoli plates of Krishna III one Dantiga is stated to have been killed along with the Vappuka by Krishna III
date_text: But the present inscription is not dated and has to be placed on grounds of palaeography in the 9th century A.D
summary: which refers itself to the reign of Jagattunga, mentions a feudatory named Dantiga, who was ruling the nadu
